from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,math,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np,yaml
from PIL import Image
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
out=Path('/out');pkg=Path(get_package_share_directory('oomwoo_gazebo'))
model_path=pkg/'models/vacuum_dock/model.sdf';model_bytes=model_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(model_bytes).hexdigest()=='d3d7ab949320b1c60c10a388014df2ef8be29129bb29d484094da9a165d45b92'

model=ET.fromstring(model_bytes).find('model')
shapes=[shape.tag for geom in model.findall('.//collision/geometry') for shape in geom]
assert shapes==['box']*4,shapes
world_path=Path('/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support/worlds/test_room.world')
tree=ET.parse(world_path);world=tree.getroot().find('world')
before=[ET.tostring(elem) for elem in world]
station=ET.SubElement(world,'model',{'name':'vacuum_dock'})
pose=[-1.325,-.5,0.,0.,0.,1.5708]
ET.SubElement(station,'pose').text=' '.join(map(str,pose))
ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(station,'include'),'uri').text='model://vacuum_dock'
assert [ET.tostring(elem) for elem in world][:-1]==before
tree.write(out/'dock_test_room.world',encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
(out/'vacuum_dock-model.sdf').write_bytes(model_bytes)
meta=yaml.safe_load(Path('/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support/maps/test_room.yaml').read_text())
base_path=Path('/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support/maps')/meta['image']
base=np.flipud(np.asarray(Image.open(base_path).convert('L'))).copy()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('existing_box_generator','/work/tools/gen_livingroom_map.py')
g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(g)
g.RES=float(meta['resolution']);g.OX,g.OY=meta['origin'][:2];g.H,g.W=base.shape

nb,nt=g.collisions_of(model,g.T_of(pose),str(model_path.parent),extra)

result=base.copy();result[extra]=0
changed=result!=base
assert changed.any() and np.all(result[changed]==0)
assert not np.any(changed & ~extra)

Image.fromarray(np.flipud(result),'L').save(out/'dock_test_room.pgm')
meta['image']='dock_test_room.pgm';(out/'dock_test_room.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(meta,sort_keys=False))
